verdict.rationale: Aider's docs let you switch models mid-session with the in-chat /model command, run local models via Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible API, and pair two models in architect mode. Community reports show it in use with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude and Gemini models, though one user hit a tokenizer error configuring Claude 3 Opus, which is a setup issue rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: a first-party documented list of supported hosted providers and model-selection syntax in the pack, consistent hands-on evidence that provider configuration works smoothly.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: During your chat you can switch models with the in-chat /model command.
